executive_summary: Three interconnected witnesses (complainant's brother, complainant's mother, and an associate linked to the brother) construct a danger narrative against the defendant without any verified contact between witnesses and defendant. Each witness exhibits self-incriminating conduct that undermines their own credibility: the brother downloaded 10GB about someone he claims to have had blocked, the associate (Testigo-A) downloaded 10GB about someone she claims not to know, and the mother makes claims about a person her son's associate never met. CAIE composite=0.0040 (NOISE) — all testimony artifacts have high spoofability (0.85-0.90) and low prior_trust (0.10-0.15). Accusations against the defendant do not meet SUSPICION threshold. The coordinated testimony pattern itself constitutes SUSPICION for witness manipulation.

peircean_analysis.firstness: Testigo-A (KIWI-006-A01): downloaded 10GB of material about the defendant, claims not to know her, declares fear, has direct link to complainant's brother. Brother (KIWI-006-A02): downloaded material about defendant, defendant has had brother blocked for years (making real-time monitoring technically impossible), cannot present screenshots, does not know his own phone number. Mother (KIWI-006-A03): declares defendant is dangerous and 'meddles with' complainant's sister — defendant has never met the sister. Structural summary (KIWI-006-A04): three linked witnesses, zero independent witnesses, testimonies converge on a danger narrative.
peircean_analysis.secondness: Legitimate witness testimony is independent — witnesses do not share a common interest or organizational link to each other. Here: all three witnesses are linked to the complainant (brother, mother, associate of brother). None can be cross-examined independently. Each witness's testimony contains a self-incriminating structural anomaly: (a) Testigo-A downloaded 10GB about someone she 'does not know' — the quantity of material directly contradicts the claimed lack of relationship. (b) The brother claims to monitor the defendant's content in real time but the defendant has had him actively blocked for years — physical impossibility of the claimed surveillance channel. (c) The mother asserts dangerous contact between the defendant and a person the defendant has never met. These are not credibility gaps — they are internal contradictions within each testimony.
peircean_analysis.thirdness: The testimonies are not independently generated accounts of witnessed events. They are coordinated narrative contributions to a pre-assembled 'danger' characterization. The pattern is Grice Quantity violation (brother omits amount downloaded; peripheral witness knows exact amount), Grice Quality violation (mother asserts facts about a non-existent relationship), and Grice Relation violation (Testigo-A's fear testimony is irrelevant to any verified interaction with defendant). The structural signature is testimony-by-network, not testimony-by-observation: witnesses testify to what the danger narrative requires, not to what they personally witnessed.

grice_analysis_manual.note: audit_grice_maxims tool returned error (dict encoding issue). Manual Peircean application of Grice maxims follows.

maxim_quality.description: Testigo-A claims fear of someone she does not know. Mother asserts facts about interactions between defendant and a person defendant never met. Neither testimony is grounded in direct observation.

maxim_quantity.description: Brother (the most active downloader of defendant's material) does not declare quantity. Peripheral Testigo-A knows the exact amount (10GB). The person with the most information conceals it; the person furthest from the download knows it precisely. This inverse precision pattern is a Grice Quantity violation indicating active concealment by the brother.

maxim_relation.description: Testimony about a sister the defendant has never met is irrelevant to any verified interaction. The testimony is designed to expand the danger narrative beyond verifiable facts.

maxim_manner.description: The coordinated testimony uses vague threat language ('dangerous', 'crazy', 'meddling') without specific verifiable incidents, making the claims difficult to falsify — a deliberate ambiguity.

caie.daubert: 0/4 artifacts structurally irrefutable. WARNING: No irrefutable anchor. Weak under cross-examination.
caie.interpretation: All testimony artifacts have spoofability 0.85-0.90 and prior_trust 0.10-0.15. The CAIE correctly evaluates the accusations as NOISE — the testimony does not reach evidential weight sufficient for SUSPICION against the defendant.

hypotheses.H1_testimony_accurate: Witnesses independently witnessed dangerous behavior and are reporting honestly.
hypotheses.H2_coordinated_testimony: Witnesses are linked to complainant and coordinated testimony to construct a danger narrative, each contributing elements the others could not refute.

refutation_protocol.benign_hypothesis: H1: Witnesses sharing a social circle with the complainant may independently have observed concerning behavior without prior coordination.
refutation_protocol.test_result: H1 REFUTED: (A) Zero independent witnesses — all three are structurally linked to complainant. (B) Each testimony contains an internal self-defeating contradiction (10GB download by someone who 'does not know' the subject; surveillance claim over a blocked contact; facts about a non-existent relationship). These contradictions are not consistent with honest misrecollection — they are structural artifacts of manufactured testimony. (C) The brother's Grice Quantity violation (concealing his download quantity while peripheral witness knows the exact figure) indicates active concealment, not honest uncertainty.
refutation_protocol.refutation_outcome: H1 REFUTED. Testimonies are not credible as independent evidence against defendant. H2 (coordinated testimony construction) is consistent with all observed structural anomalies.

devil_advocate: The witnesses may have legitimate concerns about the defendant's behavior that are difficult to document forensically. Social connection to the complainant does not automatically invalidate testimony. The 10GB download by Testigo-A could indicate genuine research born of real concern. Counter: the technical impossibility of the brother's surveillance claim (blocked contact, cannot monitor in real time) establishes that at least one core testimony element is factually false, not merely unverifiable.

findings.title: Accusations Against Defendant — Insufficient Evidence

findings.secondness: Zero independent witnesses; all testimony contains internal contradictions
findings.thirdness: Testimony does not meet minimum evidential threshold for any finding against defendant
findings.corroboration: None — no independent source corroborates any specific harmful act by defendant

findings.title: Coordinated Witness Testimony — Structural Manipulation Pattern
findings.firstness: Brother conceals download quantity; peripheral witness knows exact amount; mother testifies to non-existent relationship
findings.secondness: Grice Quantity, Quality, and Relation maxims violated across all three testimonies
findings.thirdness: Testimony constructed to serve narrative rather than report observed facts

refutation_gate_log.gate_applied: Daubert Corroboration Gate — no irrefutable anchor
refutation_gate_log.gate_result: INTENT REJECTED pre-emission. Testimony evidence has spoofability 0.85-0.90. Cannot confirm deliberate coordination vs. convergent honest misrecollection without independent verification of the blocked status and download logs.
refutation_gate_log.forensic_note: SUSPICION is the correct conservative verdict. Full INTENT requires independent verification of: (1) active block confirmation from defendant's device, (2) download metadata from brother's device, (3) police or court records confirming sister never met defendant.
